quiet: What did they see, and how do we know this is true?
The residents are mostly poor and elderly, and many visitors come each summer.
The department handles complaints, and its key functions include outreach.

The moon looked bright that night, so we went inside early.
The rules are simple, because each player starts with five cards.
The bridge closed in May and repairs will take a year.
Nobody answered the phone, so she tried again later.
